purpose: Independently qualify a Reference Richards temporal policy for the frozen realistic Hupsel atmospheric workload without using candidate error to select the policy.

selection_rule: Select T64 as P6B target only if it completes all six materials and daily T64-vs-T128 metrics are finite. Otherwise T128 may become target only if it completes all six; no further ladder is authorized here.
